1use either::Either;
2use serde::Deserialize;
3use std::path::PathBuf;
4
5#[derive(Default, Deserialize, Eq, PartialEq)]
6#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
7pub enum Target {
8	Bin,
9	#[default]
10	Lib
11}
12
13/// Default value for [`Config::out`].
14fn default_out() -> PathBuf {
15	String::from("README.md").into()
16}
17
18/// Default value for [`Config::default_features`].
19fn default_true() -> bool {
20	true
21}
22
23/// Configuration for `cargo-doc2readme`. This struct is meant to be read from a file
24/// or filled with default values, and then augmented from the cli arguments.
25#[derive(Deserialize)]
26#[serde(deny_unknown_fields, rename_all = "kebab-case")]
27pub struct Config {
28	/// Path to `Cargo.toml`. Will be passed to `cargo metadata` if set.
29	#[serde(default)]
30	pub manifest_path: Option<PathBuf>,
31
32	/// Package to read. Will be passed to `cargo metadata` if set.
33	#[serde(default)]
34	pub package: Option<String>,
35
36	/// Output File. By default the output will be written to `README.md`.
37	#[serde(default = "default_out")]
38	pub out: PathBuf,
39
40	/// Template File. By default `cargo doc2readme` will look for a file called
41	/// `README.j2` and use its own builtin template if no template was found.
42	///
43	/// If you specify a template here, you opt out of the builtin template. If the
44	/// template does not exist, an error will be returned.
45	///
46	/// The template is processed by [`minijinja`]. Most jinja2 syntax is supported.
47	#[serde(default)]
48	pub template: Option<PathBuf>,
49
50	/// If set to true, nightly rustc will be used to expand macros prior to reading the
51	/// source. This is necessary if you use function-like macros in doc attributes as
52	/// introduced in Rust 1.54.
53	#[serde(default)]
54	pub expand_macros: bool,
55
56	/// List of features to activate. This can either be a space or comma separated
57	/// string, or a list.
58	///
59	/// This option is only useful when [`expand_macros`](Self::expand_macros) is enabled.
60	/// Otherwise this option does nothing.
61	#[serde(default, with = "either::serde_untagged_optional")]
62	pub features: Option<Either<String, Vec<String>>>,
63
64	/// If set to true, enable all features.
65	///
66	/// This option is only useful when [`expand_macros`](Self::expand_macros) is enabled.
67	/// Otherwise this option does nothing.
68	#[serde(default)]
69	pub all_features: bool,
70
71	/// If set to false, disable default features.
72	///
73	/// This option is only useful when [`expand_macros`](Self::expand_macros) is enabled.
74	/// Otherwise this option does nothing.
75	#[serde(default = "default_true")]
76	pub default_features: bool,
77
78	/// Selects which target to pick when searching for the rustdoc. By default, this is
79	/// set to `lib`, in which case library targets will be preferred over binary targets.
80	/// If set to `bin`, binary targets will be preferred over library targets instead.
81	#[serde(default)]
82	pub preferred_target: Target
83}
84
85impl Default for Config {
86	fn default() -> Self {
87		toml::from_slice(&[])
88			.expect("An empty configuration file should be valid. This is a bug.")
89	}
90}
